roles.name: Worker
roles.startup_script:
set -euo pipefail
nvidia-smi || true
WT=/mnt/afs/haonan/hoi3r/HOI3R/.worktrees/feat-dcf-anchor-uvz-static
RUN_DIR=$WT/logs/v2ablate/dt10_directjoints_activeright_nmax1_cam836_151652c_g4_20260512/seed0
EVAL_DIR=$RUN_DIR/eval_publish
PRIOR=$WT/logs/v2ablate/dt10_directhandonly_joints2d3d_head1024x5_offset0_4ee7f91_cam836212060125_p1_1gpu_rerun_pt-30d9c1f2/seed0
export WT RUN_DIR EVAL_DIR PRIOR
cd $WT
git config --global --add safe.directory $WT || true
git rev-parse HEAD
mkdir -p $EVAL_DIR/manifests $EVAL_DIR/test3
cp $PRIOR/eval_publish/manifests/test3.json $EVAL_DIR/manifests/test3.json
export PYTHONPATH=$WT:$WT/third_party/wan/Wan2.2
/mnt/afs/haonan/miniconda3/envs/human3r/bin/python scripts/hoi3r_v2/p2_eval_thfm_lora.py \
  --ckpt $RUN_DIR/final.pt \
  --manifest $EVAL_DIR/manifests/test3.json \
  --dataset dexycb \
  --vae-cache /mnt/afs/haonan/hoi3r/cache/wan22_vae_dexycb_full \
  --gt-cache-dir /mnt/afs/haonan/hoi3r/cache/dexycb_gt_multiseq_v3_6_camera0_9d20aa4_r4 \
  --clip-len 13 \
  --n-max 1 \
  --thfm-train-mode lora \
  --lora-rank 16 \
  --lora-alpha 32 \
  --head-mid-dim 1024 \
  --object-head-mid-dim 1024 \
  --head-num-layers 5 \
  --max-manifest-size 3 \
  --output-dir $EVAL_DIR/test3 \
  --device cuda:0 \
  2>&1 | tee $EVAL_DIR/test3_eval.log
test -s $EVAL_DIR/test3/metrics.json
test -s $EVAL_DIR/test3/predictions.pt
/mnt/afs/haonan/miniconda3/envs/human3r/bin/python - <<'METRICS_PY'
import json, os
from pathlib import Path
metrics_path = Path(os.environ["EVAL_DIR"]) / "test3" / "metrics.json"
pred_path = Path(os.environ["EVAL_DIR"]) / "test3" / "predictions.pt"
metrics = json.loads(metrics_path.read_text())
overall = metrics.get("overall", {})
detection = overall.get("detection", {})
side = overall.get("hand_side_acc", {})
def mean_metric(name):
    node = overall.get(name, {})
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        return (node.get("per_frame") or {}).get("mean")
    return node
summary = {
    "metrics_json": str(metrics_path),
    "metrics_json_size": metrics_path.stat().st_size,
    "predictions_pt": str(pred_path),
    "predictions_pt_size": pred_path.stat().st_size,
    "detection_precision": detection.get("precision"),
    "detection_recall": detection.get("recall"),
    "detection_f1": detection.get("f1"),
    "hand_side_acc": side.get("overall"),
    "hand_joint_l2_mm_mean": mean_metric("hand_joint_l2_mm"),
    "hand_mesh_l2_mm_mean": mean_metric("hand_mesh_l2_mm"),
    "obj_add_s_mm_mean": mean_metric("obj_add_s_mm"),
    "obj_rot_deg_mean": mean_metric("obj_rot_deg"),
    "obj_trans_mm_mean": mean_metric("obj_trans_mm"),
}
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
METRICS_PY
